description: This file defines functions and constants for quick retrieval of glyph advance widths in the FreeType font rendering library, including functions FT_Get_Advance and FT_Get_Advances, and a flag FT_ADVANCE_FLAG_FAST_ONLY.

methods.name: FT_Get_Advance
methods.description: Retrieves the advance width of a specific glyph in a font face, in 16.16 fixed-point format if scaled, or font units otherwise.

methods.name: FT_Get_Advances
methods.description: Retrieves advance widths for multiple glyphs in a font face, in 16.16 fixed-point format if scaled, or font units otherwise.
